final_claim: For exactly one noisy tandem duplication of fixed length k, where the copied block differs in exactly one coordinate, the worst-case number of distinct length-n parents is 2 floor(m/(k+1))+min(2,m mod(k+1)) with m=n−k+1, independently of alphabet size q≥2.
limitations: Exactly one noisy duplication with exactly one substituted coordinate in the copied block.
